prompt_en: An unmistakably adult bookish woman in her mid-twenties stands with her back against the sun-warmed white wall of a beachside pavilion, holding a weathered paperback against her chest. An unmistakably adult athletic blond man in his late twenties, deeply suntanned, wears an open coral resort shirt over a white tank and plants one palm flat on the wall beside her head and leans toward her in a clearly readable one-arm wall-brace gesture, directing the pose toward her. The scene reads as a tense beachside encounter between contrasting adult personalities. His cocky half-smile becomes a briefly serious, attentive gaze as the paperback tilts between them. He keeps his open braced hand visible beside the same woman; her startled composure breaks into a quick sideways glance toward him, and the paperback drops a few centimeters between them. A medium two-shot keeps both adult faces, his open hand, and the paperback in one crisp relational plane while turquoise surf and beach grass soften behind them. Low golden sunlight rims his blond hair and bounces from the white wall across her face, balancing warm skin against cool water. Cinematic editorial photography, 50mm lens, natural skin texture, believable hands, shallow depth of field.
